triggerReasons.message: A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: a stalled story cannot mint another ordinary review round without a current-round resolution
acceptanceBindings.note: Blocking gate at the REVIEW re-entry mint; converging trend not falsely blocked.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: structured resolution actions incl. declare-unreachable clear the block / close the loop; empty or stale ones do not
acceptanceBindings.note: Signed current-round record; declare-unreachable reuses B-1909 withdrawn-disposition + reconciles plan (F-059).

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: a hard ceiling/override caps rounds and the adjudication does not double-count with the convergence-breaker or story_resume --ack
acceptanceBindings.note: Review-round vs advance accounting kept independent; each brake clears only via its own path.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: one registered RED-first mutation-killing smoke reproduces the stall refusal, the F-058 unreachable scenario, and breaker non-interference
acceptanceBindings.note: Behavioral proof through real entry points; registered in validate.

note: B-7813 acceptance bindings: all four deliverables core; none may be withdrawn for an empty-scope PASS.
